code: import EventEmitter from"events";import{managerEvents,expConfig}from"./config";import{inventoryManager}from"./InventoryManager";import{getSkillValue}from"utils";class PlayerManager{constructor(){this.rmListeners=[];this.emitter=new EventEmitter();this.skillLevels={health:1,attackCoolDown:1,move:4,parry:0,bow:0,meleeWeapon:1,magic:0,lockBreaking:1};this.skillExp={health:0,attackCoolDown:0,move:0,parry:0,bow:0,meleeWeapon:0,magic:0,lockBreaking:0};this.getLevelUpValue=skill=>{const _100Percent=expConfig.volume*expConfig.multiplier*(this.skillLevels[skill]+1);const currentExp=this.skillExp[skill];const _1PercentExpValue=_100Percent/100;const currentPercent=currentExp/_1PercentExpValue;return{_100Percent,currentPercent,currentExp,_1PercentExpValue};};this.levelUp=skill=>{const oldLevel=this.skillLevels[skill];this.skillLevels[skill]=oldLevel+1;this.skillExp[skill]=0;this.emitter.emit(managerEvents.UPDATE_SKILL,this.skillLevels);};this.getSkillValue=skill=>getSkillValue(skill,this.skillLevels,inventoryManager.equipment);this.listenChangeValue=(skill,callBack)=>{const updateSkill=()=>{const currentSkillValue=this.getSkillValue(skill);callBack(currentSkillValue);};this.emitter.addListener(managerEvents.UPDATE_SKILL,updateSkill);return()=>{this.emitter.removeListener(managerEvents.UPDATE_SKILL,updateSkill);};};this.listenAllSkills=callBack=>{this.emitter.addListener(managerEvents.UPDATE_SKILL,callBack);return()=>{this.emitter.removeListener(managerEvents.UPDATE_SKILL,callBack);};};const rmEquip=inventoryManager.listener("equip",()=>{this.emitter.emit(managerEvents.UPDATE_SKILL);});this.rmListeners.push(rmEquip);}}export const playerManager=new PlayerManager();
